fact: INE's Anuário de Estatísticas de Comércio Externo, June 2024 edition, gives definitive 2024 external trade results (exports -0.90% in dollars, imports -4.82% in dollars versus 2023); the page does not name the record-holder, which INE's quarterly trade editions give as AGT customs data.
title: Anuário de Estatísticas de Comércio Externo (ECE)
